newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's Mubarak leaves for Paris, Washington.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Mubarak leaves for Paris, Washington.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak left Cairo for Paris on Friday on his way to an official visit to the United States, airport sources said.
Mubarak will have talks with French President Jacques Chirac during his stopover in Paris on Friday and arrive in Washington on Saturday, official sources said.
Palestinian President Yasser Arafat passed through Cairo in the hours before Mubarak left, on his way home to Gaza from his own visit to the United States.
Egyptian officials said earlier that Arafat would brief Mubarak on his talks in Washington but they could not confirm that such a meeting did take place on Friday morning.

Mubarak's talks abroad will concentrate on the problems in Middle East peace talks, most topically Israel's decision to build more houses for Jews in East Jerusalem and Palestinian complaints about the area Israel is offering to withdraw from in the next round of Israeli redeployment in the West Bank.
In Washington he will also meet bankers and businessmen to explain the opportunities opened by his government's widely acclaimed economic reform programme.
